x: Jim Heathfield was second in the 440 and Terry Bateman won the high jump. Tea and sandwiches were provided afterwards by our hosts, prominent among whom were our old friends Syd Jarlett and Bill Speaight..
Bill Sutton, Jock Mackenzie and Ans Bergvalds will be available for the Shot and Discus backed up by Doug. Childs, Terry Bateman, Len Higgins, Doug.
Bergvalds, our Latvian member, won the weight and discus events and Terry Bateman won the javelin throw. Final points were: Belgrave H. 53; Woodford Green A.C. 37.

Childs was second in the Shot Putt and third in the Discus Throw and Terry Bateman also helped us out in these events. Alan Bishop and Archie Bedford were first home in the 880 yards and Archie also ran a good race to win the 1 mile in 4.34.
Terry Bateman will, we hope, show considerable improvement, and with Doug Whitehead, now back in “civvy street” aftr getting a R.A.F. Blue at this event, perhaps we shall see some better throwing.
